rows.jyutping: jung6 tai2 m4 hei2 jan4 ge3 hau2 man5
rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for saying that someone speaks in a disparaging or insulting manner.

example.english: They spoke disparagingly, saying that we couldn't even handle this small task.
example.traditional: 佢用睇唔起人嘅口吻話我哋連呢啲小事都做唔掂。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jung6 tai2 m4 hei2 jan4 ge3 hau2 man5 waa6 ngo5 dei6 lin4 ni1 di1 siu2 si6 dou1 zou6 m4 dim6
